## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (Tech 4/5 in Top 5) and large-cap Tech divergence (AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND) versus broad sector gains — two confirmations for CAUTION.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Staples lead: TGT (1W: +10.33% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND, KHC (1W: +8.02% | 1M: +7.13%) ABOVE TREND. Semiconductors/Tech strength concentrated: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy is weakest: XOM (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -2.35%) BELOW TREND and sector flat to down. Big-cap Tech lagging: AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -8.05%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +13.51% | 1M: +17.83%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (Tech 4/5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ADBE (1W: -18.86% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -13.83% | 1M: -2.97%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -10.42% | 1M: +0.29%) TREND EXHAUSTION, NOW (1W: -9.16% | 1M: +17.35%) TREND EXHAUSTION, INTU (1W: -6.75% | 1M: -25.55%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in large-cap software.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND; watch for MAJOR DIVERGENCE as mega-cap Tech is selling while semis lead — tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed and concentrated in semiconductors. Semis ABOVE TREND: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND; but mega-cap Tech BELOW TREND: AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth net positive but internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive and broad. JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) ABOVE TREND and Financials showing 1W strength supporting risk-on tilt in cyclicals within a cautionary regime.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Modestly positive with pockets of strength. JNJ (1W: +3.48% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +1.83%) ABOVE TREND while AMGN and MDT headlines add idiosyncratic risk.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to semiconductor and select cyclical names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND action (INTC, AMAT, LRCX, JPM, TGT) and reduce exposure to large-cap software and megacap Tech that are BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, META); style mixed — semis momentum vs defensive/financial stability. Monitor narrow leadership and earnings/news flow before scaling core positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +10.33% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -18.86% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Semiconductors/Tech hardware (led by INTC, AMAT, LRCX) — confirmed ABOVE TREND names. BEARISH: Large-cap software/Big Tech where several names are BELOW TREND and showing trend exhaustion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch INTC short-term extension and consolidation after +25% week, AMAT follow-through above recent breakout (ABOVE TREND), AAPL downside follow-through below current support could signal deeper Tech re-pricing, JPM above-trend continuation for Financials strength.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+65): IMAAVY breakthrough/priority review; JNJ (1W: +3.48% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. AMD (+55): Meta AI chip pact; AMD (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +14.83%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. GOOGL (+55): Anthropic backing for data centers; GOOGL (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ADBE (-50): bank downgrades on AI strategy; ADBE (1W: -18.86% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. BA (-50): delivery deferral headlines; BA (1W: +1.67% | 1M: -8.96%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — news is bearish while price shows short-term bounce (divergence). CRM (-50): activist/positioning headlines; CRM (1W: -10.42% | 1M: +0.29%) TREND EXHAUSTION — sentiment aligns with selling.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with style mixed / no clear leadership. INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength while AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -18.86% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND are material weaknesses to monitor, amplified by negative sentiment on some names. Watch concentrated semi leadership versus broad mega-cap Tech divergence and news-driven catalysts (JNJ positive, ADBE/AMGN negative) for next confirmation.
